_about: Per-phoneme 'softness' weights (ARPAbet, stress digits removed). +1 = round/soft ('bouba'), -1 = sharp/spiky ('kiki'). Based on the direction of effects reported in the sound-symbolism literature (e.g. Nielsen & Rendall 2011; Cwiek et al. 2022): sonorants, voiced stops and rounded back vowels read as round; voiceless stops and front unrounded vowels as spiky. Magnitudes are a judgement call - edit freely and rebuild.
